origin_note: screen px (1080 x 2424 stage) where the SVG's (0, 0) sits when the actor is at rest
format: Draft motion format for rivc. Every track targets a <g id> in the SVG; a group's pivot is its translate() origin. Properties: x, y (absolute, in the parent's units), rotation (degrees, clockwise), scaleX, scaleY, opacity, strokeWidth, fillColor ('#RRGGBB'). Keys are [time s, value]; 'ease' applies between keys (linear, hold, sine, quadIn). driver 'time' clips play on the clock; driver 'input:<name>' clips are scrubbed, clip time = input value. mixBy names an input whose value (0..1) is the clip's blend weight. The SVG's own transforms are each group's setup pose.
